predictions.selection_reason: user-controlled variable name -> embedded in assignment code -> potential scope pollution if not properly escaped
predictions.source_summary: node.object.name comes from SymbolNode constructor which accepts a string parameter. This name is parsed from user input expressions like 'a=2' where 'a' becomes the symbol name.
predictions.sink_summary: setSafeProperty(scope, jsName, value) assigns a value to a property on the scope object using the symbol name as the property key.
predictions.guard_summary: setSafeProperty validates that the target object is a plain object and prevents overriding inherited properties like constructor/toString. The stringify function escapes double quotes in the property name. SymbolNode validates that the name is a string.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled symbol names from parsed expressions are used as property keys in scope assignments. While stringify escapes quotes and setSafeProperty has some validation, the property name itself is not validated against a whitelist of safe property names.
used_variable_sources: node.object.name (from SymbolNode constructor, derived from parsed user input)
called_function_context: setSafeProperty (validates plain object and prevents overriding inherited properties)
enclosing_conditions: if (!node.index) - only for direct variable assignments like 'a=2'
predictions.context_summary: The code compiles assignment expressions to JavaScript. For direct variable assignments (no index), it uses setSafeProperty to assign values to the scope object using the symbol name as the property key.
unresolved_facts: Whether there are additional validation layers in the expression parsing that restrict symbol names
Whether the scope object has any additional security controls beyond setSafeProperty validation
Whether there are any known dangerous property names that could be exploited despite the existing controls

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: dynamic property name assignment without validation, property injection vulnerability
retrieval_query.sensitive_operation: dynamic property assignment to scope object
retrieval_query.missing_control: no validation of property names against dangerous patterns

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: When escaping special characters using a meta-character like backslash or ampersand, the meta-character has to be escaped first to avoid double-escaping, and conversely it has to be unescaped last to avoid double-unescaping.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output operations. Implement proper escaping for HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and URL contexts.
